la tabla case_area_comments existe y es una tabla
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='case_area_comments' AND c.relkind='r'
"total": 1
RLS esta habilitada (fail-closed: sin politicas no hay acceso)
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_class c WHERE c.oid='public.case_area_comments'::regclass AND c.relrowsecurity
"total": 1
las 3 politicas propias existen (select/insert/update)
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_policy WHERE polrelid='public.case_area_comments'::regclass
"total": 3
el area es vocabulario cerrado en la base, no texto libre

SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.case_area_comments'::regclass AND contype='c' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%BACK_OFFICE%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%HELPDESK%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%SCHOOL_SERVICES%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%FINANCE%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%ADDITIONAL%'

updated_at se mantiene con el disparador compartido del proyecto
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='public.case_area_comments'::regclass AND NOT tgisinternal AND tgname='case_area_comments_set_updated_at'
"total": 1
anon NO tiene ningun privilegio (la plataforma los otorga por defecto al crear la tabla)
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) g WHERE c.oid='public.case_area_comments'::regclass AND g.grantee='anon'::regrole
"total": 0
authenticated NO tiene ningun privilegio: el navegador nunca habla con la base
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) g WHERE c.oid='public.case_area_comments'::regclass AND g.grantee='authenticated'::regrole
"total": 0
project_admin si tiene SELECT, INSERT y UPDATE

SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) g WHERE c.oid='public.case_area_comments'::regclass AND g.grantee='project_admin'::regrole AND g.privilege_type IN ('SELECT','INSERT','UPDATE')
"total": 3
